record.title: Validate bounded FRAM read transaction contract offline
record.intent: Prepare an exact-completion read primitive without contacting the device.
requirements: Correlate pinned stock CFram page_read and fram_read semantics with available pinned Linux reference UAPI and transfer return conventions. Keep reference provenance separate from stock binary and physical evidence.

Implement only a deterministic offline transaction core for address0x50, two-byte big-endian offset selection,16-byte reads within8192bytes and exact two-message completion. No real device opening or ioctl implementation.
Verify ARM64 struct layout and host positive/short/negative/out-of-bounds controls; preserve artifacts. No physical contact, reads, installation or reboot.
Record live descriptor/node/adapter identity and capture prerequisites still needed by any future physical wrapper.
acceptance: The read primitive and remaining physical wrapper obligations are testable and explicit.
